decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page, this approved vertigo combination tablet still has unresolved market prospects and costs little to keep listed, so the option is worth holding open.
Once the generic antidepressant capsule is registered, keeping it on the market costs little, and one year is too short to judge whether its tender and pharmacy uptake will pay off.
The combination antihypertensive serves a large chronic market, has a dedicated page and early-stage uncertainty, so the low-cost option to expand later should stay open.
The supplement gets only a passing mention, which suggests lower commitment and a more crowded market, but there is no clear evidence yet that its value will not materialize, so it stays for now.
